title: Display snapshot replans a second copy into the same readback buffer but completes on the first copy's fence
source: Introduced by c4288a5 (PR #125); raised in the PR #125 review; fixed in f877ee3.

expected.what: The planner records another copy of the same serial into the same snapshot buffer every 500 ms while the snapshot is incomplete, so a copy can be planned while an earlier copy into that buffer is still on the GPU.
Every replanned copy signals the same completion value (the serial), so the first copy to finish marks the buffer final while a later copy may still be writing it.
poll_display_snapshot takes the buffer as soon as the completed value reaches the serial, so the CPU can read a READBACK buffer an in-flight GPU copy is still writing.

evidence: All replanned copies write one buffer and report one completion value. The fix counts plans per serial, signals (serial << 8 | plan) and makes both the replan guard and the poll wait for the latest plan.
